**Current positioning (what the journal accepts now):** This is not a standing journal with rolling submissions -- it is an annual conference-proceedings volume. Authors must be ACPA members at time of submission, submit a full paper (max 15 double-spaced pages) plus 150-word abstract by the yearly deadline (30 April for the 2026 cycle), and, if accepted, must deliver the paper in person at the November conference and sign over copyright to ACPA. The 2026 volume (published from the Nov 2026 conference) is themed "The ACPA at 100: Living Tradition" -- historical, analytical, and phenomenological approaches to tradition, mentorship, death/life, and the intellectual life in relation to Catholic belief, with named touchstones Newman, Arendt, and MacIntyre.

**Methods noted as welcome (qualitative — not a scored 0-5 table, see Methodological Preferences below):** metaphysics, epistemology, moral theory / applied ethics, philosophy of religion, history of philosophy, political philosophy, philosophy of science, historical/analytical/phenomenological approaches (per 2026 CFP)

**Fields deliberately left blank, and why:**
- **ai_policy**: No AI/generative-AI use policy found on ACPA's website, the CFP PDF, or the publisher (Philosophy Documentation Center) site; PDC's general site pages were not reachable (403) and no journal-specific or publisher-wide AI policy text was located via search.
- **preprint.allowed**: No preprint/self-archiving policy stated anywhere found (ACPA CFP, PDC listing, Wikipedia); note item 5 of the CFP says authors 'agree to allow the ACPA to hold the copyright' upon acceptance, which bears on but does not directly state a preprint policy.
- **experiential.review_time_months**: SciRev has no entry for this journal (page returned 404 / no listing found); only the structural CFP-to-decision window (~3 months) is documented, which is not a first-hand reviewer report.
- **experiential.desk_reject_pct**: No SciRev, forum, or first-hand source reports a desk-reject rate; only a vague Wikipedia note that acceptance rate 'varies depending on the number of papers submitted.'
- **experiential.reviewer_culture**: Zero results across muchong.com, zhihu, fabiaoji-style Chinese academic forums, and Reddit r/AskAcademia for this journal -- it is too niche/small-circulation (small annual Catholic philosophy association conference proceedings) to have generated first-hand reviewer-experience discussion in any searched forum.
